topic: ML data results and AFA reporting
summary_markdown: A meeting was held to discuss the total results from ML data and how to explain the data differences for AFA. Next actions were defined, including preparing a report with data difference explanations for AFA, analyzing ML data against current data, sending emails regarding postponed API release (new version) and a new dashboard, setting priorities (releasing the new dashboard with old asset management, hiding impression data), and preparing instructions for the new dashboard.
decisions: A report explaining data differences for AFA must be prepared.
action_items: Prepare report for AFA with data diff explanation
Analyze ML data and compare it with current data
Send email about postponed API release (new version)
Set priority to release new dashboard (mops) with old asset management
Hide the box with impressions data
Prepare instructions about new dashboard (in 2-3 weeks)
